content.intro: M1: Introduction to Sustainable Energy System Transformation

content.text: A robust policy and regulatory framework is essential for effective energy governance. This section examines the development of policies and regulations that support a <ai prompt="What is just energy transition?">just energy transition 💬️</ai>, emphasizing the importance of political economy analysis, stakeholder engagement, policy coherence, foresight, adaptive policies and regulations, and de-risking investments.

lessons.title: Lesson 1: Policy Coherence
lessons.description: This lesson examines how political and economic factors shape energy governance, emphasizing the need for political economy analysis (PEA) and Institutional and Context Analysis (ICA) to navigate challenges and advance just energy transitions.

lessons.title: Lesson 2: Strategic Foresight for Energy Governance
lessons.description: This lesson explores strategic foresight as a tool for anticipating future energy challenges and opportunities, utilizing methodologies like horizon scanning, scenario planning, and backcasting to enhance risk management, policy flexibility, and investment strategies for resilient and adaptive energy transitions.

lessons.title: Lesson 3: Adaptive Policies and Regulations
lessons.description: This lesson explores how adaptive policies and regulations ensure flexibility, resilience, and effectiveness in energy governance by incorporating continuous monitoring, stakeholder engagement, innovation incentives, and Regulatory Impact Assessment (RIA) to respond to evolving challenges.
